title: Jonah and the Trail
author: Ines Kavanagh
blurb: Petra Vasquez, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
